title: Sīlasampadādisuttapañcakaṃ
text: ‘‘Nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yena anuppanno vā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo uppajjati, uppanno vā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati, yathayidaṃ, bhikkhave, sīlasampadā…pe… yathayidaṃ, bhikkhave, chandasampadā…pe… yathayidaṃ, bhikkhave, attasampadā…pe… yathayidaṃ , bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampadā…pe… yathayidaṃ, bhikkhave, appamādasampadā…pe…. Chaṭṭhaṃ.
